overview: The committee reviewed and finalized the draft for the Medford City Council newsletter. The approved version includes updates on recent council business regarding waste collection and municipal solar infrastructure.

items.title: Medford City Council Newsletter Draft
items.summary: Approved the council newsletter draft with added summaries regarding a resolution on bi-weekly trash collection and a proposed 20-year solar power agreement for the McGlynn School. The committee authorized the chair to incorporate additional commemorations and acknowledgements into the final version prior to publication.
